name: follow_bench_0320
description: follow_bench_0320 is an instruction-following benchmark that tests a model's ability to follow natural-language directions and produce appropriate, useful outputs. The dataset contains a variety of follow-up and directive-style prompts that evaluate conversational grounding, compliance, and helpfulness across short-form tasks. It is used primarily to assess instruction-following quality rather than closed-form correctness.
reputation: A small community dataset used by some developers for instruction-following experiments; not widely standardized in benchmark suites.
